title: Private versioned broker policy and Role captures
x-invariants: Legacy policy and Role JSON bytes retain their original shape and digest.
Caller policy is the complete accepted capture. Activation compares it with the accepted receipt and does not reopen authoring inputs.
Caller Role reference, configuration, instruction bytes and Profile binding match the corresponding child in the accepted policy capture.
Logical policy SHA-256 hashes the installed policy within captures; Role SHA-256 hashes the entire versioned Role snapshot. Private captures never enter observer projections.
